:::{#exr-euclidean-distance-practice}
#### Finding the distance between two customers' feature vectors

A nearest-neighbour method compares two customers through the [Euclidean distance](#def-euclidean-distance)
between their feature vectors.
Two customers have feature vectors

$$
\vx = \sbmat{1 \\ 0 \\ 3},
\qquad
\vy = \sbmat{3 \\ 1 \\ 1}.
$$

Find $d(\vx, \vy)$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @def-euclidean-distance with $p = 3$.

:::

:::
